sql.schedule.getUserPositionIdsForUsers: select id from flow.user_position up where user_id = any(array[ :userIds ]::int[])
sql.schedule.getEventsByProject: select p.id, p.project_name, c.id as contact_id, c.phone, c.mobile, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(steps))) FROM ( SELECT ps.process_step_name as "processStepName", pps.id as "projectProcessStepId", ps.id as "processStepId", cfg.event_type_id as "eventTypeId", et.event_type as "eventType", (select timestamp_value from flow.project_process_step_custom_field_value start inner join flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga on start.custom_field_group_assignment_id = cfga.id where start.project_process_step_id = pps.id and start.archived is not true and cfga.archived is not true and cfga.custom_field_group_id = cfg.id and cfga.schedule_field_type_id = 1 ) as start, (select timestamp_value from flow.project_process_step_custom_field_value cfv_end inner join flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga on cfv_end.custom_field_group_assignment_id = cfga.id where cfv_end.project_process_step_id = pps.id and cfv_end.archived is not true and cfga.archived is not true and cfga.custom_field_group_id = cfg.id and cfga.schedule_field_type_id = 2 ) as "end", (select case when sl.system_list_type_id = 1 then o.org_name else concat(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) end as resource_name from flow.project_process_step_custom_field_value resource inner join flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga on resource.custom_field_group_assignment_id = cfga.id left join flow.user_position up on up.id = resource.int_value left join flow.user u on u.id = up.user_id left join flow.org o on o.id = resource.int_value inner join flow.custom_field cf on cf.id = cfga.custom_field_id inner join flow.company_system_list csl on csl.id = cf.company_system_list_id inner join flow.system_list sl on sl.id = csl.system_list_id where resource.project_process_step_id = pps.id and resource.archived is not true and cfga.archived is not true and cfga.custom_field_group_id = cfg.id and cfga.schedule_field_type_id = 3 ) as "resourceName" from flow.project_process_step pps inner join flow.process_step ps on pps.process_step_id = ps.id inner join flow.custom_field_group cfg on ps.id = cfg.process_step_id and cfg.event_type_id is not null and cfg.archived is not true inner join flow.event_type et on cfg.event_type_id = et.id where pps.project_id = :projectId and pps.archived is not true and pps.main is true order by start, "end" ) steps), '[]') AS "events" from flow.project p inner join flow.contact c on p.contact_id = c.id where p.id = :projectId and p.archived is false
sql.schedule.getEvents:
with resource as ( select ppscfv.id, ppscfv.custom_field_group_assignment_id, ppscfv.project_process_step_id, ppscfv.int_value, cfga.custom_field_group_id, cfga.custom_field_id, cfg.group_name, cfg.event_type_id from flow.project_process_step_custom_field_value ppscfv inner join flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga on cfga.id = ppscfv.custom_field_group_assignment_id inner join flow.custom_field_group cfg on cfg.id = cfga.custom_field_group_id where cfg.archived is not true and cfga.archived is not true and cfga.schedule_field_type_id = 3 and ppscfv.int_value is not null and ppscfv.int_value = any(array[ :combined ]::int[]) ), start_time as ( select ppscfv.id, ppscfv.custom_field_group_assignment_id, ppscfv.project_process_step_id, ppscfv.timestamp_value, cfga.custom_field_group_id from flow.project_process_step_custom_field_value ppscfv inner join flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga on cfga.id = ppscfv.custom_field_group_assignment_id inner join resource r on r.project_process_step_id = ppscfv.project_process_step_id where cfga.schedule_field_type_id = 1 ), end_time as ( select ppscfv.id, ppscfv.custom_field_group_assignment_id, ppscfv.project_process_step_id, ppscfv.timestamp_value, cfga.custom_field_group_id from flow.project_process_step_custom_field_value ppscfv inner join flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga on cfga.id = ppscfv.custom_field_group_assignment_id inner join resource r on r.project_process_step_id = ppscfv.project_process_step_id where cfga.schedule_field_type_id = 2 ) select r.group_name, r.event_type_id, evt.event_type, pps.process_step_id, pps.project_id, pps.id as project_process_step_id, sl.system_list_type_id, st.timestamp_value as start, et.timestamp_value as "end", r.int_value as resource_id, u.id as user_id, c.id as contact_id, c.first_name as contact_first_name, c.last_name as contact_last_name, c.phone, c.mobile, p.latitude, p.longitude, p.street1, p.city, p.postal_code, s.abbreviation as state_abbreviation, case when sl.system_list_type_id = 1 then o.org_name else concat(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) end as resource_name, p.project_name, ps.process_step_name, p.company_state_id, s.state, pps.company_process_step_status_type_id, cpsst.process_step_status_type from resource r
inner join flow.project_process_step pps on pps.id = r.project_process_step_id inner join end_time et on et.project_process_step_id = pps.id and et.custom_field_group_id = r.custom_field_group_id inner join start_time st on st.project_process_step_id = pps.id and st.custom_field_group_id = r.custom_field_group_id inner join flow.project p on p.id = pps.project_id inner join flow.company_project_status_type cpst on cpst.id = p.company_project_status_type_id inner join flow.process_step ps on ps.id = pps.process_step_id inner join flow.company_process_step_status_type cpsst on cpsst.id = pps.company_process_step_status_type_id inner join flow.contact c on c.id = p.contact_id inner join flow.company_state cs on cs.id = p.company_state_id inner join flow.state s on s.id = cs.state_id inner join flow.custom_field cf on cf.id = r.custom_field_id inner join flow.event_type evt on evt.id = r.event_type_id left join flow.user_position up on up.id = r.int_value left join flow.user u on u.id = up.user_id left join flow.org o on o.id = r.int_value inner join flow.company_system_list csl on csl.id = cf.company_system_list_id inner join flow.system_list sl on sl.id = csl.system_list_id where st.timestamp_value is not null and et.timestamp_value is not null and r.int_value is not null and p.archived is false and case when :startTime::timestamp is not null and :endTime::timestamp is not null then st.timestamp_value between :startTime::timestamp and :endTime::timestamp OR et.timestamp_value between :startTime::timestamp and :endTime::timestamp else 1=1 end and case when :isParent then ps.company_id = any (select id from flow.company_hierarchy_filter_down(:parentCompanyId::int)) else ps.company_id = :companyId end and ps.archived is not true and case when pps.cancelled_date is null --pps.cancelled_date is a new column so we have to check it for now then cpsst.process_step_status_type_id != 3 --dont include cancelled process steps else pps.cancelled_date >= st.timestamp_value::timestamp end -- cancelled_date > start time means it was cancelled AFTER the appt and so we want to show it. cancelled_date < start time means cancelled before start time and dont want to show it ....right?? and (p.cancelled_date is null or p.cancelled_date >= st.timestamp_value::timestamp) --Only remove an appointment if the project was cancelled prior to the appointment start time (it currently pulls off all cancelled projects)
sql.schedule.getProjects: select cfg.group_name, pps.process_step_id, pps.project_id, ps.company_id, sl.id as system_list_id, array_to_json(resource_cf.system_list_option_ids) as system_list_option_ids, pps.id as project_process_step_id, sl.system_list_type_id, start_cfv.timestamp_value as start, start_cfv.id as start_custom_field_value_id, start_cfga.id as start_custom_field_group_assignment_id, start_cf.field_name as start_field_name, start_cf.readonly as start_field_read_only, end_cfv.timestamp_value as "end", end_cfv.id as end_custom_field_value_id, end_cfga.id as end_custom_field_group_assignment_id, end_cf.field_name as end_field_name, end_cf.readonly as end_field_read_only, resource_cfv.int_value as resource_id, resource_cfv.id as resource_custom_field_value_id, resource_cfga.id as resource_custom_field_group_assignment_id, resource_cf.field_name as resource_field_name, resource_cf.readonly as resource_field_read_only, c.first_name as contact_first_name, c.last_name as contact_last_name, p.latitude, p.contact_id, p.longitude, case when sl.system_list_type_id = 1 then o.org_name else concat(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) end as resource_name, p.project_name, ps.process_step_name, p.company_state_id, s.state, p.street1, p.city, p.postal_code, s.abbreviation as state_abbreviation, pps.company_process_step_status_type_id, cpsst.process_step_status_type, cpsst.process_step_status_type_id from flow.project_process_step pps inner join flow.process_step ps on ps.id = pps.process_step_id inner join flow.custom_field_group cfg on cfg.process_step_id = pps.process_step_id inner join flow.company_process_step_status_type cpsst on cpsst.id = pps.company_process_step_status_type_id inner join flow.project p on p.id = pps.project_id inner join flow.contact c on c.id = p.contact_id inner join flow.company_state cs on cs.id = c.company_state_id inner join flow.state s on s.id = cs.state_id left join flow.custom_field_group_assignment start_cfga on start_cfga.custom_field_group_id = cfg.id and start_cfga.schedule_field_type_id = 1 left join flow.custom_field_group_assignment end_cfga on end_cfga.custom_field_group_id = cfg.id and end_cfga.schedule_field_type_id = 2 left join flow.custom_field_group_assignment resource_cfga on resource_cfga.custom_field_group_id = cfg.id and resource_cfga.schedule_field_type_id = 3 left join flow.project_process_step_custom_field_value start_cfv on start_cfv.project_process_step_id = pps.id and start_cfv.custom_field_group_assignment_id = start_cfga.id left join flow.project_process_step_custom_field_value end_cfv on end_cfv.project_process_step_id = pps.id and end_cfv.custom_field_group_assignment_id = end_cfga.id left join flow.project_process_step_custom_field_value resource_cfv on resource_cfv.project_process_step_id = pps.id and resource_cfv.custom_field_group_assignment_id = resource_cfga.id left join flow.custom_field start_cf on start_cf.id = start_cfga.custom_field_id left join flow.custom_field end_cf on end_cf.id = end_cfga.custom_field_id left join flow.custom_field resource_cf on resource_cf.id = resource_cfga.custom_field_id left join flow.user_position up on up.id = resource_cfv.int_value left join flow.user u on u.id = up.user_id left join flow.org o on o.id = resource_cfv.int_value left join flow.company_system_list csl on csl.id = resource_cf.company_system_list_id left join flow.system_list sl on sl.id = csl.system_list_id where case when :isParent then ps.company_id = any (select id from flow.company_hierarchy_filter_down(:parentCompanyId::int)) else ps.company_id = :companyId end and ps.archived is not true and p.archived is false and case when :isParent then p.company_state_id in (select id from flow.company_state where state_id = (select state_id from flow.company_state where id = :companyStateId)) else p.company_state_id = :companyStateId end and cfg.archived is not true and case when start_cfv.timestamp_value is not null then start_cfv.timestamp_value >= :startTime::timestamp else 1=1 end and case when end_cfv.timestamp_value is not null then end_cfv.timestamp_value <= :endTime::timestamp else 1=1 end and cfg.event_type_id = any(array[ :eventTypeIds ]) and cpsst.process_step_status_type_id = :processStepStatusTypeId order by start, p.project_name

sl.system_list_type_id = 1 then o.org_name else concat(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) end as resource_name, p.project_name, ps.process_step_name, p.company_state_id, s.state, pps.company_process_step_status_type_id, cpsst.process_step_status_type, cpsst.process_step_status_type_id, case when sl.id is not null then coalesce(( SELECT pps.process_step_id inner join flow.company_process_step_status_type cpsst on cpsst.id = pps.company_process_step_status_type_id inner join flow.project p on p.id = pps.project_id inner join flow.project_process_step_custom_field_value resource_cfv on resource_cfv.project_process_step_id = pps.id and resource_cfv.custom_field_group_assignment_id = resource_cfga.id left join flow.custom_field start_cf on start_cf.id = start_cfga.custom_field_id left join flow.custom_field end_cf on end_cf.id = end_cfga.custom_field_id left join flow.custom_field resource_cf on resource_cf.id = resource_cfga.custom_field_id left join flow.user_position up on up.id = resource_cfv.int_value left join flow.user u on u.id = up.user_id left join flow.org o on o.id = resource_cfv.int_value left join flow.company_system_list csl on csl.id = resource_cf.company_system_list_id left join flow.system_list sl on sl.id = csl.system_list_id where case when :isParent then cpsst.process_step_status_type_id = :processStepStatusTypeId::int end
sql.schedule.searchProjectsByName: select c.first_name as contact_first_name, c.last_name as contact_last_name, c.id as contact_id, concat(c.first_name, ' ', c.last_name) as contact_full_name, p.project_name, p.id as project_id from flow.project p inner join flow.contact c on c.id = p.contact_id where c.archived is not true and case when :isParent then c.company_id = any (select id from flow.company_hierarchy_filter_down(:parentCompanyId::int)) else c.company_id = :companyId end and (concat(c.first_name, ' ', c.last_name) ILIKE '%' || :search || '%' OR p.id::text = :search) order by c.first_name, c.last_name
